newsitem.title: USA: Tracor to refinance debt, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: Tracor to refinance debt, sees charge.

text.p: Tracor Inc said Friday it would incur a one-tine after-tax charge of $10 million in connection with a program to restructure its debt.

Tracor said it expected to enter into a $200 million revolving credit facility and issue $200 million of senior subordinated notes. This will allow it to refinance its existing bank debt and consummate a tender offer to purchase $115.9 million of outstanding 10-7/8 percent senior subordinated notes, it said.
Subject to the delivery of definitive documentation and the satisfaction of other customary condidtions, the company expects the financings to close before March 31.
Tracor said the restructuring will extend the senior debt and subordinated debt maturity periods, reduce interest expense, and result in the $10 million charge.
Tracor is a defense electronics firm whose 1996 sales were more than $1 billion.
